title: Observation Assimilation Transformer (OAT)
description: Code of the paper 'Observation Assimilation Transformer: Probabilistic Weather Analysis from Sparse Station Observations'. OAT makes probabilistic weather analysis fields from coarse NWP fields and sparse station observations.
